# lobbyhop

> Agent-first multiplayer for browser games and experiences. Share a link, play together. One game definition (rules as plain functions) is shared by browser and server; lobbyhop provides rooms (URL codes, lobby, reconnect, host, spectators, chat), sync (lockstep or authoritative state sync), hosting (Cloudflare Durable Objects or Node) and tests (in-memory network harness, N-browser e2e, cross-engine determinism).

To integrate, follow skills/lobbyhop/SKILL.md. Docs ship in the package: `npx lobbyhop docs ls`, `npx lobbyhop docs cat <name>`.

## Docs

- [Integration skill](skills/lobbyhop/SKILL.md): step-by-step recipe for agents
- [Guide](docs/GUIDE.md): concepts, game definition, client wiring, hosting, testing, retrofitting
- [Choosing a sync model](docs/CHOOSING.md): lockstep vs state sync, genres, tick rates, latency
- [Determinism](docs/DETERMINISM.md): the lockstep contract, audit, cross-engine verification
- [Deploy](docs/DEPLOY.md): Cloudflare, Node (Fly, Railway, Render, Docker), scaling, costs
- [API reference](docs/API.md): every export by entry point
- [Protocol](docs/PROTOCOL.md): wire messages and turn semantics
- [Troubleshooting](docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md): symptoms, fixes, known pitfalls
- [Roadmap](docs/ROADMAP.md): replays, matchmaking, accounts, anti-cheat, voice, prediction, rollback

## Examples

- [counter](examples/counter/game.ts): smallest lockstep game
- [arena](examples/arena/game.ts): real-time lockstep, interpolation, ghosts, bots
- [tictactoe](examples/tictactoe/game.ts): turn-based state sync
- [cursors](examples/cursors/game.ts): lobby-less real-time state sync
